about: The burner is not lit again by the thermostat before the wait is up: Start at 2 s, the water climbs to 60.5 at 400 s and the fire smouldering from 394 s burns out by itself (the flame goes dark at 490 s) and stops at 567 s; the water cools through the line of 56 at about 495 s to 50 at 620 s. The wait is 4 minutes (auto_lock_min): the card counts 240 down from 568 s, the order is Keep where it would be Burn, and the fire is lit again at 808 s (the flame is back at 871 s). The same run with no wait lights it at once, a Start in the middle of the wait lights it then, and water under the floor lights it when it crosses it.
